messages:
Priya (Procurement): CostGauge sent a credits-based SOW. quick: how do credits map to tokens/embeddings and rollover rules?
Amelia (Finance): need deterministic mapping and a sample invoice CSV for our AP parser. pilot prefers net-45.
Jon S (Eng Ops): POC numbers: ~1.2M tokens + 47k embeddings. long-context spikes matter.
Nina - CostGauge: baseline 1 credit = 1k inference tokens OR 10 embedding units. long-context multiplier: >1k = 1.8x, >4k = 2.5x. we'll include exact table.
Sasha R (Platform): multipliers per-request or adjusted for KV caching?
Nina - CostGauge: per-request at compute time; we report tokens_in/out and billable_credits after cache deductions.
Priya (Procurement): rollover? previous vendor wiped unused quarterly which was bad.
Nina - CostGauge: options: quarterly (25% rollover) or annual (100% rollover with small maintenance fee).
Amelia (Finance): sample invoice lines please (commit, used, overage, setup, tax).
Nina - CostGauge: sample: "Commit Q2 - 150,000 credits @ $0.30 = $45,000", "Overage - 11,200 credits = $3,360", "Setup (VPC) = $6,000". will attach CSV + PDF.
Jon S (Eng Ops): can you push per-request CSV (request_id, model_variant, tokens_in, tokens_out, billable_credits, timestamp) to our S3?
Nina - CostGauge: yes, S3 or presigned link.
Sasha R (Platform): SOC2 + BYOK for Private? and any discounted spot/background credits?
Nina - CostGauge: SOC2 Type II yes. BYOK via AWS KMS supported. background credits at 40% off, tagged in logs and not usable for low-latency routes.
Priya (Procurement): setup fee negotiable?
Nina - CostGauge: we can reduce setup to $3,500 with a 12mo commit.
Amelia (Finance): Accounting Bot run the sample invoice once uploaded and flag mapping issues.
Accounting Bot: ready  drop CSV link and I'll run a dry parse and post diffs within 2hrs.
Priya (Procurement): next steps: Nina uploads multiplier table + mock invoice, Accounting Bot parses, Amelia confirms net-45 budget, Sasha validates BYOK/spot. ack?
Amelia (Finance): ack 
Jon S (Eng Ops): ack 
Sasha R (Platform): ack 
Nina - CostGauge: thanks  I'll upload in ~45m and hold the $3.5k concession for 48hrs.
